goal.title: HTTP build goal: bench vise (live exercise)
goal.statement: a small bench vise with a fixed jaw, a sliding jaw and a lead screw with a handle, two steps

rationale: Build it in 2 steps, each adding to the model the step before it kept.

tasks.title: Step 1 of 2 — Base and Fixed Jaw
tasks.instruction: Construct the stationary base plate and attach the fixed jaw vertically to one end.

tasks.title: Step 2 of 2 — Sliding Mechanism
tasks.instruction: Install the lead screw through the fixed jaw and attach the sliding jaw and handle to complete the clamping mechanism.
